title: Treasury and Cash Management
overview: Effective treasury and cash management is critical for organizations to optimize their use of funds while managing exposure to risks, such as fluctuations in interest rates and foreign exchange rates. This course delves into the key responsibilities of corporate treasury, including cash flow and liquidity management, working capital optimization, accessing debt financing, and managing capital.

Participants will gain a comprehensive understanding of the tools and techniques necessary for managing treasury risks effectively. This program is designed to provide a strong foundation for professionals seeking to master the principles of treasury and cash management.
audience: This course is tailored for treasury professionals, financial managers, finance controllers, accountants, bankers, traders, dealers, finance regulators, and corporate professionals involved in treasury and cash management functions.
methodology: The course employs a blend of interactive techniques, including concise presentations by subject matter experts, practical application of theoretical concepts, and group exercises to foster knowledge sharing and hands-on learning.
competencies: Valuation of equity and fixed income securities
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Understand and articulate the roles and responsibilities of corporate treasury and its functions.
Apply modern practices in asset-liability and cash management.
Develop a practical understanding of financial markets and instruments.
Measure financial instruments in compliance with IFRS and GAAP.
Explain the concept of fair value and its impact on financial instruments.
Differentiate between hedging and speculation and implement treasury-specific hedging strategies.
